subject: Re: BlueHat pen-test — access matrix, regional scope, and remediation tracking
messages:
From: BlueHat Security <eng@bluehatsec.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@acmepayments.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — data we need to lock the scope and access windows

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick kick-off call earlier — per our notes we need two clarifications before we lock the testing windows:

1) A machine/asset export (IP, hostname, role, region) for the staging and pre-prod clusters. CSV is fine.
2) Short-lived SSH/RDP credentials for a single bastion + a list of IAM roles we can assume (we'll use ephemeral keys).
3) Confirmation whether the scope includes eu-west-1 and asia-southeast-1 regions (the SRE team mentioned EU only at first).

Also, please confirm whether the pen-test report will be shared with Acme Payments or redacted for internal Redwood-only findings. We ask because we maintain two delivery templates.

Attachments: none (we'll provide a template to map assets)

Thanks,
Alex Ramsey
Senior Consultant — Engagements
BlueHat Security
eng@bluehatsec.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

--
BlueHat: sample report turnarounds ~7 business days after final evidence handoff.
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: BlueHat Security <eng@bluehatsec.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@acmepayments.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — data we need to lock the scope and access windows

Alex — thanks. Short answers inline:

1) Asset export: attaching a first-pass CSV (redwood-asset-export-20270322.csv). It includes hostname, private/public IP, role tag, and region. It does NOT currently break out autoscaled ephemeral instances (we will add those per your request).

2) Ephemeral creds: we can provide a single-bastion jump host with time-bound keys. Dylan (SRE) is looped for the ticket and exact TTL.

3) Regions: Confirmed scope should include us-west-2 and eu-west-1. We asked to exclude asia-southeast-1 for this engagement due to data residency concerns — Acme confirmed exclusion on the call (Cc’ed Alex). If BlueHat needs a separate APAC pass, we can scope it as a follow-up.

Report sharing: we need Redwood findings redacted for customer-facing deliverable then produce an internal detailed report (two artifacts). Agree to use BlueHat's report template for the external redacted copy.

Next steps: Dylan, can you create the bastion creds ticket and attach the SSH instructions we discussed? Once BlueHat confirms the exact assume-role ARNs they need, we'll finish the IAM allowlist.

Thanks,
Sofia
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-asset-export-20270322.csv
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, BlueHat Security <eng@bluehatsec.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff — bastion creds ticket + SSH instructions

FYI: created SEC-TICKET-7823 for the bastion access.

Ticket summary: generate time-bound SSH key pair and temporary user on jb-bastion1 for bluehatsec_eng (valid 72 hours, start 2027-03-25 09:00 PST). Add CloudTrail read-only role and the assume-role ARNs once provided.

Attached: staging-ssh-access-instructions.txt (contains steps and an example command).

From: BlueHat Security <eng@bluehatsec.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@acmepayments.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — assume-role ARNs + clarification on assets to test

Thanks Dylan — a few clarifying points after we reviewed the CSV:

- We see a mix of "role" tags. Please clarify which hostgroups are considered in-scope for unauthenticated URL fuzzing vs. credentialed testing. Example: api-cards-prod vs api-cards-preprod. We will only run unauthenticated scanning against prod hostnames unless you confirm otherwise.

- Please confirm RDS snapshot access: do you want read-only queries against replicas or we should omit DB layer entirely?

- We require the following assume-role ARNs (sample): arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/BlueHatPenTestAssumeRole. If you prefer not to create an IAM role, we can accept short-lived keys for the bastion as discussed.

- Proposed adjusted schedule: evidence handoff complete by 2027-03-25 17:00 PST; active testing 2027-03-26 through 2027-03-30; report draft 7 business days after final evidence handoff. Any conflicts?

Attached: bluehat-report-matrix-template.xlsx (template for mapping findings to redaction matrix).

Alex Ramsey
BlueHat Security
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: BlueHat Security <eng@bluehatsec.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@acmepayments.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — assume-role ARNs + clarification on assets to test

Alex/Dylan — update:

- In-scope hostgroups: api-*/preprod, staging, and non-cardholder prod APIs (tagged "pci-exclude"). We explicitly exclude cardholder prod endpoints from credentialed testing; unauthenticated scanning permitted only against the public edge. We will mark exclusions in the CSV (column: testing_allowlist).

- DB access: omit direct RDS queries. BlueHat can validate via read-only replica snapshots only if Acme procurement signs off; otherwise, DB layer out-of-scope for this engagement.

- IAM: we've created the role ARN: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/BlueHatPenTestAssumeRole. Dylan — please add the assume-role permission and the CloudTrail read-only policy. Dylan confirms bastion ticket SEC-TICKET-7823 is scheduled to provision keys on 2027-03-25 09:00 PST.

- Schedule: the proposed adjusted schedule looks good. Evidence handoff now set for 2027-03-25 12:00 PST to accommodate some final asset labeling. Active testing to start 2027-03-26 09:00 PST.

Attachments: signed-scope-amendment.pdf (formalizes region and db exclusions).

Thanks,
Sofia
Security Program Manager
From: BlueHat Security <eng@bluehatsec.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@acmepayments.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final access confirmed + draft deliverable matrix and next steps

Sofia — confirmed on our side. We validated the assume-role ARN and the bastion key window; we performed a quick smoke auth on 2027-03-25 and confirmed we can reach the allowed hostgroups.

Per the attached matrix (bluehat-report-matrix-template.xlsx) here's the delivery cadence we will follow:
- 2027-03-30: End of active testing (handful of re-tests finish same day)
- 2027-03-31: Internal triage + classification (internal BlueHat)
- 2027-04-08: External redacted report to Acme Payments (using agreed redaction matrix)
- 2027-04-13: Internal detailed report to Redwood (full findings, PoCs, remediation steps)

We also flagged three medium findings during initial smoke that we will validate during active testing — summary below. We will use the redaction matrix to produce the customer-facing artifacts.

Please notify us if Redwood wants to keep a tighter window (we can compress deliverable dates but that affects turnarounds).

Thanks again,
Alex Ramsey
BlueHat Security

Attachments: bluehat-report-matrix-template.xlsx, final-test-log-snippet.txt
